subject: Adopt Organization Agent Mesh Primary operating contract for this project
summary: The AI Behaviour Control Lab adopts the Primary-agent operating contract from the Intercommunications Enhancements framework as project-local policy: bind immutably to this project before mutable work; validate project communication policy; inherit project binding to child agents; keep ordinary AgentBus traffic intra-project; deny cross-project mutation by default; preserve human/project governance gates; make the Primary responsible for accepted-state integration, project isolation, release coherence, and final promotion of reviewed self-enhancement candidates; require compatibility/risk review and regression validation before grafting shared behavior; rebuild and verify affected PRIMARY/MANAGER/RESEARCH packages when shared protocol or role behavior changes; use canonical project persistence before any Slack/external delivery; and never infer Slack destinations or use Slack as canonical state.
